moves.name: Chloroblast

moves.name: Buddy Chloroblast
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user’s Speed is raised.
Deactivation Condition: Cannot be deactivated.

Never misses. Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with this attack become critical hits. Lowers the target’s Sp. Def by 2 stat ranks. Turns the field of play’s terrain into EX Grassy Terrain the first time this attack move is successful each battle.

moves.name: Remarka-ball Fireworks!
moves.description: Reduces the sync move countdown of an ally by 1. Raises an ally’s Sp. Atk by 4 stat ranks. Raises an ally’s critical-hit rate by 3 stat ranks.

passives.name: Heartwarming Handcrafted Ball
passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 1 the first time it enters a battle each battle. Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 1 the first time its sync move is used each battle. Increases the Special Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by 2 ranks after using the user’s sync move or max move.

subPassives.name: Head Start 1
subPassives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 1 the first time it enters a battle each battle.

subPassives.name: Adrenaline 1
subPassives.description: Reduces the sync move countdown by 1 the first time the user’s sync move is used each battle.

subPassives.name: S-Move/Max Move: Team Special Boost ↑2 9
subPassives.description: Has a chance (100%) of increasing the Special Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by 2 ranks after using the user’s sync move or max move.

passives.name: Galar Rush
passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 1 the first time it enters a battle each battle. When used in a co-op battle, reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 1 the first time your team enters a battle each battle instead. The more allied sync pairs with the Galar theme you have on your team, the greater the reduction is. (Each additional sync pair increases the reduction by one, and the maximum reduction is three.) The effects do not stack if you have more than one sync pair on your team with passive skills of the same name.

passives.name: MAX Countdown 3
passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 3 after using its max move.

passives.name: Pep Rally 2
passives.description: Raises the Speed of all allied sync pairs by 2 stat rank(s) when the user’s move is successful.

passives.name: INCREDIBALL!!!
passives.description: The user uses Explosion immediately before fainting. Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 9 just before it faints. When used in a co-op battle, reduces the sync move countdown of a player other than the user by 9 instead.

subPassives.name: Faint: Sync CD ↓ 9
subPassives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 9 just before it faints. When used in a co-op battle, reduces the sync move countdown of a player other than the user by 9 instead.

subPassives.name: Last Word
subPassives.description: The user uses Explosion immediately before fainting.
